Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. Stockholm University of the Arts, the only public higher arts school in the field after the mergers of 2014 and 2020, offers two puppetry courses, Introduction to Puppet Theatre and Introduction to Puppet Play, both as standalone courses outside any degree, one run in cooperation with the Marionetteatern at Kulturhuset stadsteatern. A standalone course is not a specialised degree-granting higher education programme: the denominator is not satisfied. The previous 0.5 was the midpoint of an estimated range. Caveat: this rests on search summaries, hence estimate and an upper bound of 1.
